scores.notes: Saul at left in robe mid-throw, spear flying past David at right toward the wall; lamps on walls, wispy smoke drifting from window as the only sign of the spirit; full-bleed, no lettering.

Young man in linen tunic by a Jerusalem gate with dropped jar and weary figures at right wall, but Jerusalem is shown twice: a temple-topped walled city on the left hill and a second temple fortress on the right, contradictory geography; little radiance touching him.

Large foreground stone at left carries carved pseudo-Latin letters ('ROMA...'), and another marker shows faint inscription; unpainted paper border around all edges (accepted). Row of markers, villagers, Roman soldier by wall otherwise match.

Alice in pinafore with clasped hands on a wood path looking up at a grinning tabby Cheshire Cat seated on a mossy bough, cottage faint behind; no lettering, full-bleed, no film-derived design evident.

Moses with raised hand and staff, Aaron in breastplate beside him, pig rooting at left, families and cooking pots by tents and the tabernacle enclosure behind; breastplate stones unmarked; cloud-and-fire radiance is absent but the scene reads.

Moses sits on a stone but raises his own right arm and grips his staff himself; Aaron only touches his elbow and Hur's hand hovers near the staff, so his hands are not held up as the verse and scene require.

Seraphim are classical angels with four wings, faces only partly hooded and bare feet showing, so not six wings covering face and feet; the right one holds tongs with a burning coal (Isaiah 6:6), breaking the rule that visionary creatures follow the text.

King hides behind Alice, floating grinning Cat head, Queen pointing at left, card courtiers; but the Queen (black bun, tiny crown, tall white collar, heart gown) closely copies the Disney animated Queen of Hearts; background also holds Alice-like girls (white pinafore at left, blue dress at right).
Darius kneels pressing his ring into red wax on the boulder closing the den, lords in embroidered dress around him, torches and lamps at night; the seal bears an ornamental motif, not letters.

Ezekiel stands among scattered skeletons with arm raised and face lifted in a barren valley under bright sky with low haze; the tablet he holds is blank, upright stones are uninscribed; no gore beyond dry bone.

Paul centered holding a bronze mirror in a colonnaded courtyard, believers in arcs behind, closed scrolls and oil lamp on ledge, city and acropolis beyond; pediment friezes are ornamental with no visible letters.
Night courtyard with central brazier and gate; Peter in foreground right looking stricken toward Jesus standing in the middle distance, bystanders and guards around; no lettering or anatomy faults.

Column of Egyptian chariots and horsemen with shields charging along wet seabed between two walls of water under dark clouds with dawn glow at the far end; distant Israelites not clearly distinguishable but the pursuit reads.

Hatherley with bandaged hands points at the burning white house with fire engines and hoses beyond rose bushes, but Holmes at right is a gaunt, slick-haired face closely resembling a screen Holmes actor (Peter Cushing type), breaking the adaptation/likeness rule.

Daniel stands small with lifted hands under fiery wheels and cloud, city on horizon; no clear figure, but in the bright radiance below the central wheel there is a faint pale shape with arm-like streaks that could read as a light figure.

Alice holds the flamingo with hedgehogs crawling, but card soldiers bear corner index glyphs ('J'-like marks on the spade cards) and dance upright in a chain rather than forming arches; the Queen at right (black bun, tiny crown, high white collar, red/yellow heart gown) copies the Disney design.

Alice on the left looking up at the grinning Cat head forming in a swirl of air, flamingo lying on the grass, hedgehogs among mushrooms, card soldiers and arches behind; card markings are pips only, no legible glyphs.
Elderly man lying on a woven mat with eyes closed, a woman kneeling at his side and family standing around between tents, well, fields and a mud-brick settlement at dusk; no faults seen.
Two burning mud-brick walled cities under falling fiery sulfur and smoke columns, orange sky, small fleeing figures at both edges; no lettering, treated without gore.

Moses with staff leads a line of Israelites carrying bundles and children along the seabed between walls of water at night, pillar of fire glowing far behind; viewed from the front rather than from behind, a minor composition difference.
Peter bends gripping the lame man's right hand as he rises beside a bronze temple gate, John watching at right, crowd and Roman soldiers behind the temple courtyard; no faults seen.

Holmes in dressing gown on the bed with flaring match and raised cane, adder on the bell-pull, Watson seated with pistol; Holmes' gaunt slicked-back face closely resembles a screen Holmes actor (Jeremy Brett/Cushing type), breaking the adaptation rule.
Lion, ox, man-faced and eagle creatures with eyed wings stand around an empty throne over a crystalline sea under a rainbow and lightning; no figure for God, throne empty.
